contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Touchscreen Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Touchscreen response issues

actions.description: It will remove interference from the screen surface

steps: Remove any third-party screen protector that is peeling or has debris under it.
Wipe the front and back gently with a lint-free microfiber cloth.
Avoid applying too much pressure while cleaning.

actions.description: It will rule out insufficient charging power

steps: Connect the device to a different, undamaged charger.
Avoid using the touchscreen while the device is charging.

actions.description: It will match screen response to your protector

steps: Tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity to enable it.

actionableDeeplink.description: Enables touch sensitivity via device Settings on the device.

steps: Tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity to disable it.

actionableDeeplink.description: Disables touch sensitivity via device Settings on the device.

actions.description: It will stop gestures from misreading your taps

steps: Select Buttons to turn off full screen gestures.

actionableDeeplink.description: Opens the navigation bar settings page in device Settings on the device.

actions.description: It will connect you with Samsung support staff

steps: Contact Samsung Support if the issue persists after these steps.

actions.description: It will clear temporary glitches affecting touch input

steps: Press and hold the Power button.

actions.description: It will keep device software fully current

steps: Check that your device software is up to date.
Check for updates to any third-party apps you use.

actions.description: It will reveal whether an app causes this

steps: Press and hold the Power button and the Volume down button at the same time.
Remove any third-party app installed around the time the issue began.
Restart the device to exit Safe mode.

actions.description: It will erase all data and restore defaults

steps: Back up your personal data before you continue.

actionableDeeplink.description: Opens the Factory data reset settings screen
actionableDeeplink.message: Open Factory data reset under General management
